tasks.short: Speak to students about future political leadership

steps.what: Read the student audience's questions and requested political-leadership topics
Choose personal political experiences relevant to encouraging these students
Speak to students and discuss developing as future political leaders

tasks.design: Retain preparation for this student audience and the legislator's actual discussion of political leadership. The existing audience document in {DOCS} supplies questions directly; no established speech-writing or reporting operation is removed in this speaking encounter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Encouragement depends on personal experience, credibility and response to the students.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document access provides audience context without removing the required personal preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Giving honest, relevant encouragement and responding to sensitive political questions.
tasks.human_edge: Connect personal political experience with students' aspirations and concerns.
tasks.altitude: No change to the elected representative's speaking responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an elected representative's personal encouragement of students depends on contextual preparation and direct interaction; a written speech is not inherent to every speaking encounter.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an informal student speaking encounter. The organizer supplies actual questions and topics, but the legislator's reading and selection of personal examples remain counted. No free staff-written speech is assumed.

Before zero, inspect invitation replies, logistics, speech preparation, written materials and follow-up sends. This task establishes speaking rather than those separate outputs; the scenario has direct audience information and no required manuscript or record. Add and assess any actual written speech or send before using zero for that workflow.

Native document access is assessed first and already direct; no repeated lookup baseline is invented. No student-progress log, transcript or activity report is introduced. No automation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual written speech, briefing or follow-up obligations
research_questions: Observe a student encounter and separate any real manuscript preparation, lookup or send from speaking.

incremental.description: No proposed implementation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 audience-reading, 10 personal-example selection and 80 speaking points. An unfamiliar student audience still needs personal contextual preparation; no actual written or repeated system operation is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain direct student encouragement and political judgement.
role.ambitious_version: No additional service is inferred from this speaking task.
